title: Three space companies selected to develop high-resolution 3D reconstruction techniques for Indian cities

ai.summary: The Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre (IN-SPACe) selected three Indian space companies to develop high-resolution 3D reconstruction techniques for Indian cities using satellite data, with pilot projects in Bengaluru and Shimla.

facts.claim: The Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre (IN-SPACe) has selected three Indian space companies to develop High-Resolution Indian Human Settlement Layers (IHSL) across Indian cities.
facts.quote: The Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre (IN-SPACe) has selected three Indian space companies to develop High-Resolution Indian Human Settlement Layers (IHSL) across Indian cities.

facts.claim: The three companies, SpacePixxel Technologies Pvt. Ltd., KaleidEO Space Systems Pvt. Ltd. and Azista Industries Pvt. Ltd. have been selected under IN-SPACe’s Seed Fund Scheme for Use Case Demonstration by Non-Government Entities (NGEi) to develop IHSL across Indian cities.
facts.quote: The three companies, SpacePixxel Technologies Pvt. Ltd., KaleidEO Space Systems Pvt. Ltd. and Azista Industries Pvt. Ltd. have been selected under IN-SPACe’s Seed Fund Scheme for Use Case Demonstration by Non-Government Entities (NGEi) to develop IHSL across Indian cities.

facts.claim: These companies will collectively receive seed funding of ₹1.46 crore to develop and demonstrate an indigenous satellite-based system for 3D reconstruction of India’s built environment using monocular imageries.
facts.quote: These companies will collectively receive seed funding of ₹1.46 crore to develop and demonstrate an indigenous satellite-based system for 3D reconstruction of India’s built environment using monocular imageries.

facts.claim: The selected companies will develop models using Earth Observation data to generate three integrated outputs covering built-up surface and building type, building height, and built-up volume.
facts.quote: The selected companies will develop models using Earth Observation data to generate three integrated outputs covering built-up surface and building type, building height, and built-up volume.

facts.claim: The pilot demonstrations will cover Bengaluru and Shimla, representing distinct urban contexts of a large metropolitan region and a hill city.
facts.quote: The pilot demonstrations will cover Bengaluru and Shimla, representing distinct urban contexts of a large metropolitan region and a hill city.
